text: The use of loads of ≤80% of 1RM allows lifters to vary concentric lifting cadence; lighter loads enhance this ability. Given that eccentric strength is approximately 20% to 50% greater than concentric strength (12), the velocity of eccentric actions can be altered at loads in excess of concentric 1RM. Some have speculated that intentionally extending the duration of repetitions leads to a superior hypertrophic response as a result of the longer time under load (1 18).
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
chapter: Chapter 4: Role of Resistance Training Variables in Hypertrophy
